summary: Build credit decisioning skills with scorecards, alternative data, model governance, and monitoring labs. Enrol in practical training today.
lede: Through practical exercises, you will analyse characteristics, interpret WOE and IV, review Gini and KS results, map alternative-data controls, design decision flows, and build a model monitoring dashboard. You will also produce a validation findings log, governance RACI, and implementation roadmap, with focused applications of Basel credit risk principles and IFRS 9 across retail, SME, and agrifinance operations.
audienceIntro: This credit decisioning training is designed for professionals who influence lending policy, analytics, model governance, portfolio performance, or supervisory review. It suits experienced banking and financial-services practitioners as well as technical specialists who need a shared operating language across credit, risk, business, IT, and compliance.
modules: Scorecards with WOE and Logistic Regression
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to credit assessment, lending policy, portfolio monitoring, risk management, data analysis, or model governance. Basic statistics and spreadsheet skills will help, but coding is not required for completion. You do not need to build production machine-learning models. Advanced analytics, explainability, and automated decision-engine integration receive conceptual or operational treatment, while scorecard analysis, governance mapping, and monitoring design receive hands-on practice.
